title: Planet-Scale Digital Twin Platform — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Integrates geographic, environmental, infrastructure, and sensor models at large spatial scales. A proposed platform that maintains a living digital twin at planetary scale: geographic, environmental, infrastructure, and sensor models integrated into one coherent model that updates as the real world changes. Planners query the twin to test interventions before touching reality. (Planetary *environmental* digital twins are covered separately in the manifest; this platform integrates all model domains.)
capabilities: Integrate geographic, environmental, infrastructure, and sensor models
Update the twin continuously from live feeds
Test interventions in the twin before reality
Report data gaps and uncertainty honestly
Serve consistent views to many simultaneous users
